TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The transaction reads pricingRuleId and pricingRuleRequest from the input parameters and obtains the audit user identifier from the USERCode request header. It invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest, auditUserId). The library retrieves the existing pricing rule and its active details from the database. If the rule does not exist, an advice is added and the operation returns without updating the rule. Otherwise, the library validates whether the rule is active, whether its status allows modification, whether a synchronized rule has active children, whether the effective start date is valid, and whether restricted fields were changed. It then validates duplicate pricing rules according to the pricing rule type and detail configuration. If validation produces advices, the operation stops. For a valid request, detail values are resolved from the database. Synchronized rules are modified by creating a new version with audit data and status PAU; rules in other modifiable states have their details synchronized, their parent identifier assigned, their status changed to PAU, and their database record updated. The resulting PricingRuleDTO is assigned to pricingRuleResponse. If the transaction advice list is not empty, the transaction sets severity EWR.

Accessed Libraries.Method: executePutPricingRules(Long pricingRuleId, PricingRuleDTO pricingRule, String auditUserId)
Accessed Libraries.Description: Modifies an existing pricing rule. It retrieves the current rule and details, validates the requested modification and duplicate configurations, resolves detail values, synchronizes or versions the rule depending on its status, writes audit and pricing rule data, and returns the modified PricingRuleDTO.
